limitations: Stages are not strictly nested by pipeline order (frames and transcript are extracted independently); this funnel is a denominator comparison, not a literal drop-off sequence. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Six-stage funnel from engine.corpus.tiers() denominators: ingested -> stats -> transcript row -> usable transcript -> frames -> analysis-ready.
title: Corpus coverage funnel
